entries.title: Luke 17:1
segments: And He said to the disciples, It is impossible but that offenses will come. But woe [to him] through whom they come!

entries.title: Luke 17:2
segments: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged around his neck and he were cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

entries.title: Luke 17:3
segments: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother trespasses against you, rebuke him. And if he repents, forgive him.

entries.title: Luke 17:4
segments: And if he trespasses against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turns again to you, saying, I repent, you shall forgive him.

entries.title: Luke 17:5
segments: And the apostles said to the Lord, Give us more faith.

entries.title: Luke 17:6
segments: And the Lord said, If you had faith as a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this sycamine tree, Be rooted up and be planted in the sea! And it would obey you.

entries.title: Luke 17:7
segments: But which of you who has a servant plowing or feeding will say [to him] immediately after he has come from the field, Come, recline?

entries.title: Luke 17:8
segments: Will [he] not say to him, Prepare something [so that] I may eat, and gird yourself and serve me until I eat and drink. And afterward you shall eat and drink.

entries.title: Luke 17:9
segments: [Does] he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I think not.

entries.title: Luke 17:10
segments: So likewise you, when you shall have done all the things commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants, for we have done what we ought to do.

entries.title: Luke 17:11
segments: And as He went to Jerusalem, it happened that he went through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

entries.title: Luke 17:12
segments: And as He entered into a certain village, ten leprous men met Him, who stood afar off.

entries.title: Luke 17:13
segments: And they lifted voice and said, Jesus, Master, pity us!

entries.title: Luke 17:14
segments: And seeing [them], He said to them, Go show yourselves to the priests. And it happened, as they went, that they were cleansed.

entries.title: Luke 17:15
segments: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back and glorified God with a loud voice.

entries.title: Luke 17:16
segments: And he fell down on [his] face at His feet, thanking Him. And he was a Samaritan.

entries.title: Luke 17:17
segments: And answering, Jesus said, Were there not ten cleansed? But where [are] the nine?

entries.title: Luke 17:18
segments: Were none found who returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?

entries.title: Luke 17:19
segments: And He said to him, Rise and go, your faith has cured you.

entries.title: Luke 17:20
segments: And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered and said, The kingdom of God does not come with observation.

entries.title: Luke 17:21
segments: Nor shall they say, Lo here! or, behold, there! For behold, the kingdom of God is in your midst.

entries.title: Luke 17:22
segments: And He said to the disciples, The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and you shall not see [it].

entries.title: Luke 17:23
segments: And they shall say to you, Lo, here! or, behold, there! Do not go away, nor follow.

entries.title: Luke 17:24
segments: For as the lightning which lights up, flashing from the [one part] under heaven, [and] shines to the [other part] under heaven, so also shall the Son of man be in His day.

entries.title: Luke 17:25
segments: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.

entries.title: Luke 17:26
segments: And as it was in the days of Noah, so it also shall be in the days of the Son of man.

entries.title: Luke 17:27
segments: They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until [the] day that Noah entered into the ark; and the flood came and destroyed [them] all.

entries.title: Luke 17:28
segments: So also as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

entries.title: Luke 17:29
segments: but the day Lot went out of Sodom, it rained fire and brimstone from the heaven and destroyed [them] all.

entries.title: Luke 17:30
segments: Even so it shall be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

entries.title: Luke 17:31
segments: In that day he who shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise, he who is in the field, let him not return to the things behind.

entries.title: Luke 17:32
segments: Remember Lot's wife.

entries.title: Luke 17:33
segments: Whoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it, and whoever shall lose [his life] shall preserve it.

entries.title: Luke 17:34
segments: I tell you, in that night there shall be two in one bed, the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

entries.title: Luke 17:35
segments: Two shall be grinding together, one will be taken, and the other left.

entries.title: Luke 17:36
segments: Two shall be in the field, one will be taken, and the other left.

entries.title: Luke 17:37
segments: And they answered and said to Him, Where, Lord? And He said to them, Wherever the body [is], there the eagles will be gathered together.
